400540101.text: Hi Katheryne, we heard that you have a new commission for us?

400540102.text: That's correct. There's a requester who has submitted a designated commission for the two of you.

400540103.text: A designated commission? Sounds like it must be pretty important. Uh, what kind of task is it, exactly?

400540104.text: Hehe, there's no need to worry. This commission is not dangerous by any means. Perhaps you have heard that Inazuma will soon be holding a major festival — the "Magnificent Irodori Festival."

400540105.text: Yay! A festival! Come to think of it, we haven't attended a festival in Inazuma for a while.

400540106.text: The Yashiro Commission and Lady Yae are responsible for all the festival preparations. The one who has requested your help is none other than Lady Yae herself.

400540108.text: Hehe, you know Miko... She always has some unusual ideas in her head. You can bet a festival planned by her is gonna be one to remember.

400540109.text: We'd better go to Grand Narukami Shrine and see what she needs us to do.

400540110.text: Lady Yae is currently at Yae Publishing House in Hanamizaka, so there's no need to go all the way to the shrine. In fact, she has instructed me to have you directly meet with her there.

400540111.text: Oh, well that's convenient enough. Let's go then!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Yae Publishing House to look for Yae Miko

400540201.text: Aratani and Kuroda, how are things coming along?

400540202.text: All the books and commissioned prints for Yae Publishing House were bound and sent out yesterday afternoon, Lady Yae.

400540204.text: We have already received word from Eipekkusu and Sailing Breeze that the materials are all in place for "Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power" and "Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?"!

400540205.text: Well done. And what about you, Onodera?

400540208.text: Oh, uh, yes Lady Yae! Everything is ready for the new issue release party.

400540209.text: You are the one who organized the plans for this release party. In other words, you are the team's fearless leader now. So please, show some confidence.

400540210.text: Besides, there's no need to be nervous. This project is destined for success, I feel quite optimistic about it.

400540211.text: I shall specially grant you leave for the next couple of days, Onodera. Please take the opportunity to have a good rest. After all, you will be very busy on the day of the release party.

400540212.text: Yes, Lady Yae. Thank you very much!

400540213.text: Alright then, is everyone clear about their assignments? Good. We are running out of time, so let's get moving! Chop chop!

400540215.text: Ah, hello little ones. I take it you have received my commission, hmm?

400540216.text: Some organizer you are! It's nearly time for the festival and you're still over here ramping things up for your light novel business! Shouldn't you be getting back to the Grand Narukami Shrine?

400540217.text: You weren't thinking of dumping all the festival preparations on us, were you? Hmph, if so, then you can forget it, Paimon won't accept such a commission!

400540219.text: My my, such harsh words... It hurts to hear that kind of talk from you two. But, as you can clearly see, I'm here working like a dog for the festival, yet you say I'm not doing my job.

400540220.text: Let me ask you, little ones, who ever said that the festival must involve the Grand Narukami Shrine?

400540221.text: Huh? But isn't that a given? This is Inazuma, after all.

400540222.text: Yes, that is true. But now that the Sakoku Decree has been lifted, Inazuma is no longer the same nation that once resisted change tooth and nail.

400540223.text: Therefore, rather than sticking to the same old traditional festival, the Yashiro Commission and I have decided to shake things up a little... This time, we'll be holding an international cultural festival, distinctly Inazuman but with a unique twist.

400540226.text: Hehe, I suppose I should start by telling you the origins of the Irodori Festival.

400540227.text: Legend has it that there were five poets in ancient Inazuma who were supremely gifted in singing and writing poetry. They are known as "The Five Kasen."

400540228.text: Every year, one of the five would present a collection of the group's poems to the Shogun for review, which would then spark cultured discussions regarding those works.

400540229.text: Thanks to them, Inazuma's culture blossomed and gained great influence at that time.

400540230.text: As time passed, people began creating various tales based on The Five Kasen. The Irodori Festival was also developed as a result to show appreciation for their works which so greatly enriched our lives.

400540231.text: Sounds like a festival that's really rooted in culture.

400540232.text: Indeed, to describe it in the words of the ancients, it'd be "refined elegance." Unfortunately, with the flow of time, people have gradually forgotten about The Five Kasen and the festival.

400540233.text: Which is precisely why I've decided to revive the Irodori Festival by...

400540234.text: Holding a cultural convention featuring light novels!

400540236.text: What about all that "refined elegance" stuff you just said?

400540237.text: Please stop looking at me with those baffled expressions. In ancient times, poetry was all the rage. But nowadays, the entertainment format of choice is light novels.

400540238.text: The important thing is not the format but the creative work itself. It is impossible to come up with anything fresh if you're stuck using some rigid format of the past.

400540239.text: Speaking of which, don't you think that the concept of "focusing on the now" perfectly suits the current Inazuma?

400540240.text: And besides, it's a great opportunity to reintroduce Inazuma to all Teyvat through light novels. As they say, it's two birds with one stone.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Irodori Festival site on Ritou

400540301.text: During the Irodori Festival, the area around the Outlander Affairs Agency will become the main exhibition space for light novels.

400540302.text: Once things are in full swing, not only will there be lots of official and fan-created work on display, there'll also be exclusive giveaways, prizes, and new release parties.

400540303.text: This small plaza in front of the International Trade Association will be called "The Five Kasen Plaza" during the festival, and nearby shops will be selling special light novel merchandise. You certainly won't want to miss out.

400540304.text: Wow, how should Paimon put this... It's definitely not your typical festival, but it sure looks like it'll be quite the party!

400540305.text: Yeah, it's like a light novel paradise.

400540306.text: Huh? Uh, Miko, what are these blank boards in the center of the plaza?

400540308.text: Ah, Lady Yae did mention that there would be some reliable helpers coming to assist with the festivities. It appears she meant you two.

400540309.text: At last, we meet again, Traveler and Paimon. Tell me, how are you faring recently?

400540310.text: Oh, it's Ayato! Wow, so even a busy guy like yourself is here to attend the Irodori Festival.

400540311.text: Preparing festivals falls under the Yashiro Commission's scope of responsibilities. Seeing as Lady Yae has poured her heart and soul into the preparations, I'm obliged to be equally dedicated.

400540312.text: Hehe. Come now Ayato, we're not strangers here. There's no need to sound so formal.

400540313.text: We were just about to discuss the boards over here. They're related to our little helpers' tasks, so I'll let you give them a detailed rundown.

400540314.text: Certainly. I assume you two already know that the Irodori Festival originated from The Five Kasen. These five boards are here for painting their portraits.

400540315.text: This Irodori Festival is not only the first major festival to be held in Inazuma since the lifting of the Sakoku Decree, it is also an event deeply rooted in culture and the arts.

400540316.text: Therefore, the Yashiro Commission has personally invited several cultural celebrities from other nations.

400540317.text: For example, the artist we have invited to paint these portraits hails from the distant land of Mondstadt.

400540318.text: The Yashiro Commission will arrange accommodations and food in Inazuma for each of the distinguished guests. However, we fear that staying in a foreign land may feel a little uncomfortable.

400540319.text: Which is precisely why it would be ideal to have someone familiar with both Inazuma and other nations of Teyvat to serve as a guide for our guests.

400540322.text: I knew you would catch on. It is our hope that you would be able to guide the guests from the harbor to their residence at the International Trade Association while providing any necessary assistance along the way.

400540323.text: This Arrival Schedule includes the details of the ships on which the guests will be arriving. All you simply have to do is go to the docks at the indicated times.

400540324.text: It's settled then. My, look at the time. I have to meet with my editors, so I must be going now.

400540325.text: During the festival, most of the Yae Publishing House's editors will be staying near the Outlander Affairs Agency. If you run into any problems, you may find them there.

400540326.text: This festival requires the full cooperation of the Tri-Commission, and there are still many minor details which require my attention, so I must excuse myself for now. I'll leave the guests in your hands.

400549901.text: All the details we need about the ships are on the timetable that Ayato gave us.

400549902.text: Let's take a closer look and be sure to pick up the passengers according to the times written on it.
